component.name: GSeek
component.summary: Find your files by what you remember

description.p: Search documents, pictures, and recordings privately from GNOME Activities. Describe what you remember in your own language, or search filenames through GNOME’s existing file index.
GSeek downloads its verified EmbeddingGemma 2 model and inference runtime during setup. Choose CPU, Vulkan, or NVIDIA CUDA. No account or cloud inference is required.
Find the right copy with improved filename matching, GNOME rank and recency, and document-text relevance. Activities avoids proven identical duplicates while Show All Results retains every copy.
Filename and indexed-text search stay responsive while the embedding model starts or is unavailable. Existing indexes and downloaded models are preserved.

Search results now combine filenames, document text, and semantic relevance. Exact filenames and titles take priority, strong meaning matches can beat incidental keywords, and matching name and content evidence receives a boost.

Activities and Show All Results use consistent ordering. Exact filenames remain discoverable beyond the broader candidate limit, and results retain their best matching passage. Existing indexes work without reindexing.
Install from a signed Flatpak repository using the downloadable install file.
Native Flatpak distribution, background portal integration, and automatic restart after installed updates.
